notes: STAGED PROPOSAL ONLY. ZERO IMPLEMENTATION AUTHORITY until this exact finite scope is independently reviewed, merged, and separately promoted into immutable trusted base-state authority. #5065 Phase A only: define transport-neutral FNS subscriber acquisition contracts, strict server-controlled EGRUL/EGRIP catalog parsing, immutable READY receipt semantics, and private atomic staging orchestration against deterministic fake/local ports. The acquisition port must expose only protocol facts actually supplied by a concrete reviewed adapter; no hostname, FTP/FTPS mode, ports, client-certificate settings, username/password behavior, passive/active data-channel behavior, retry/resume semantics or live credential handling may be invented in this phase. The archive port is an interface only: no concrete ZIP backend/dependency, package/lock change, Docker/infra change or custom decompressor is authorized until a separate reviewed choice proves the hardened extractor available for REG.RU. Required regressions: strict EGRUL/EGRIP domain/version/date/archive-name parsing; duplicate/unexpected archive rejection; listing-before/listing-after drift rejection; interrupted download never READY; local archive/XML hash binding; receipt replay against another staging identity rejected; locally injected/modified XML rejected; incomplete receipt rejected; immutable READY cannot be overwritten; acquisition and importer principals remain logically separate; no secret/certificate material in receipt/log-safe facts. Receipt proves only complete acquisition of the exact authenticated remote publication unit observed by the future concrete adapter; it never claims national Jan-1+daily coverage, FNS-signed hashes, negative INN_NOT_FOUND authority or parser/policy validity. Explicitly excluded: live FNS network access, credentials/certificates, concrete FTP/FTPS client, concrete ZIP extraction backend, source coverage/currentness authority, registry activation/source-health mutation, schema/migrations, registration behavior, enforcement activation, production mutation, UI and infrastructure. REG.RU remains the only future production acquisition contour. ROLE_ELIGIBILITY_ENFORCEMENT=false. Phase A code introduces 0 RUB mandatory recurring platform/SaaS cost. This does NOT mean the future live FNS subscriber feed is free: the current official FNS tariff is 150,000 RUB per year for one workstation/one registry (EGRUL or EGRIP), unless the owner already has a valid provisioned access; paying or provisioning that external access is outside this Phase A scope and remains a production prerequisite.
